labels._title: Order Created Event published through the message broker
labels._desc: Placing an order reaches the ORDER SERVICE, which writes a row to the ORDER table (ID, CUSTOMER_ID, STATUS, TOTAL) and publishes an Order Created Event to the MESSAGE BROKER. The CUSTOMER SERVICE on the right owns the CUSTOMER table (ID, CREDIT_LIMIT) and the RESERVED_CREDIT table (CUST_ID, ORDER_ID, AMOUNT).
